title: The impact of artificial intelligence-based clinical training on burnout among practitioners treating serious mental illness.
summary: Transformer-based NLP gave immediate feedback on CBT-psychosis practice vignettes in a randomized comparison; among 100 practitioners completing follow-up, AI-supported training did not reduce burnout versus didactic training, while fidelity/proficiency associations were observed. Attrition and a single-item burnout measure limit interpretation. Publication venue was not available in the checked primary metadata. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
